summary: Ameren Corporation and its subsidiary Union Electric Company (Ameren Missouri) via Form 8-K Item 8.01 disclosed a regulatory filing with the Missouri Public Service Commission seeking a $343 million annual electric revenue increase based on a 10.25% ROE, 52% equity capital structure, $16.7 billion rate base, and a test year ending March 31, 2026. The request includes continued use of fuel and tracker mechanisms. The MoPSC proceeding has an up-to-11-month timeline with a decision expected by May 2027 and new rates effective June 2027. This is a routine rate case filing, not a special situation; no transaction, activist campaign, or structural change is involved. Watch for the MoPSC's final authorized revenue adjustment and ROE, which will affect Ameren's earnings.
